configurations.name: backend-demo (mac/linux)
runtimeArgs: [ -f data/demo.db ] || .venv/bin/python scripts/demo_seed.py --db data/demo.db; exec .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${PORT:-8021}

configurations.name: backend-demo (windows)
runtimeArgs: if (-not (Test-Path data\demo.db)) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\demo_seed.py --db data\demo.db }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8021
